description: CStar reports healthy but real Codex-host task delegation, host validation receipt promotion, and automatic lifecycle use fail at harness-schema boundaries, forcing manual intervention and robot-like instructions.

statement: If CStar consumes a normalized Corvus harness contract, accepts equivalent current Codex v1/v2 lineage safely, derives ordinary lifecycle bindings internally, and validates against real host canaries rather than mocks alone, then the existing architecture can operate reliably without a ground-up rebuild.
